title: Korean Mixed Rice Bowl
description: A quick and easy Korean-inspired mixed rice bowl with a variety of nutritious ingredients.

ingredients.name: No-sauce vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as bean sprouts, shredded carrots, chopped green onions

ingredients.name: No-sauce nuts
ingredients.notes: such as chopped peanuts or almonds

instructions: 1. Cook the mixed rice according to package instructions.
2. Heat the cooked haricot beans in a pan with a little bit of oil.
3. Add the cooked Korean kimchi to the pan with the haricot beans and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
4. Assemble the mixed rice bowl by placing the cooked rice at the bottom, followed by the haricot bean and kimchi mixture, then the nutritious greens, no-sauce nuts, and no-sauce seeds.
